title: The Mystery Islands
victoryHeadline: Caught! Turns out no island is lonely enough.
acts: The pleasure ferry Periwinkle struck a reef in full view of nobody, went down in four feet of water, and scattered its passengers across five small islands and a startled local shark population. Desert Island filled up fastest and organised itself worst. Ayla planted herself at the tideline with a notebook, timing exactly when the shark cruising her stretch of water surfaced and vanished, delighted to have finally found a vocation. Nearby, Bastian stood wedged between his two cacti, sunglasses fused on by three days of sun cream, trying to work out which plant had more water left and steadily losing. Up on the dune, Denise flashed a hand mirror at a distant shape she was certain was a rescue plane and was, on any fair reading, a gull. Emma had abandoned rescue altogether for a scale-model sand replica of the sunken Periwinkle, funnel included, and Helena had simply moved into the island's one house and spent the afternoon sweeping the sand back out the door it kept blowing in through.

Town Island had real houses, which meant Town Island had real politics. Fred took the southernmost doorstep, declared himself Mayor of the South, and spent the afternoon issuing proclamations to three people who all had somewhere else to be. Two of them were mid-argument: Nikita had come back from raiding the empty houses with tinned peaches and a pair of oversized sunglasses she maintained, loudly and often, had always been hers, and Lyra — settled firmly in the shade of the island's only tree and refusing to be moved for the emergency or anyone in it — disagreed just as loudly. Between the two of them, Irene stood at the north waterline, fending a curious shark off with a broken oar while relaying a full and careful inventory of the peaches south to Nikita, who could not hear a single word of it over the noise of the surf and the argument both.

Out past the shallows, two people chose not to make landfall at all. Olivia trod water with great calm, counting — for perhaps the fourth time that hour — exactly how many people were south of her, and declining to worry until the number gave her cause. Not far east, Cassius floated on his back, spectacles fogged, delivering an increasingly detailed lecture on maritime salvage law to the shark drifting beside him, a skill thirty years at the bar had apparently not gone to waste. Further out still, on the smallest island in the whole archipelago, Vincent paced the shore with a pencil and a plank, drafting the Official Rescue Rankings for all sixteen castaways and awarding himself first place after careful, entirely impartial deliberation. Beside him, Michael spent a quiet, useful afternoon wedging the island's sagging doorway beam back into place with a branch cut from the shrub and another from the tree, while Vincent read the rankings aloud from the top — right up until the tannoy crackled on with an announcement nobody wanted to hear twice.

whereabouts.A: Ayla sat at the Desert Island tideline with a notebook, tracking exactly when the shark known to patrol her stretch of water surfaced and vanished, quietly convinced she had found her true calling.
whereabouts.B: Bastian, wedged squarely between his two cacti with his sunglasses welded to his face by three days of sun cream, spent the afternoon working out which plant had more water left in it and losing.
whereabouts.C: Cassius floated on his back out in the open sea, spectacles fogged, delivering an increasingly detailed argument about maritime salvage law to the shark drifting beside him — thirty years at the bar, it turned out, hadn't gone entirely to waste.
whereabouts.D: Denise spent the whole afternoon up on the dune flashing a hand mirror at what she was completely certain was a search plane, and was, by any fair assessment, a gull.
whereabouts.E: Emma had given up on rescue by lunchtime and was building a scale replica of the sunken Periwinkle out of wet sand, funnel and all, and would not be rushed.
whereabouts.F: Fred took the southernmost doorstep on Town Island, declared himself Mayor of the South, and spent the day issuing proclamations to three people who were all busy with something else.
whereabouts.G: Graham knelt in the forest sand rubbing two sticks together with total conviction, six rows south of Joseph, and had produced, after several hours, a very warm pair of sticks and a beard he would later describe as a close call.
whereabouts.H: Helena walked into the desert's one house, decided it was hers, and spent the afternoon sweeping the sand back out the door it kept blowing in through, because somebody had to keep a bit of order.
whereabouts.I: Irene stood at the town's north waterline fending a curious shark off with a broken oar while shouting a full inventory of the peaches south to Nikita, who could not hear a word of it over the surf.
whereabouts.J: Joseph stood beside a forest tree, east of Lyra, shaking it steadily on the settled theory that trees produce food if asked properly, which this one had not yet agreed was true.
whereabouts.K: Kent had barricaded himself alone inside the forest's only house and was several hours into a formal, written inventory of his three biscuits, a task he found more soothing than anyone watching through the gap in the door really understood.
whereabouts.L: Lyra had claimed the shade under Town Island's only tree and was refusing, on principle, to move for anyone, having decided a pair of sunglasses she'd found that morning were rightfully hers and this was the hill she'd chosen.
whereabouts.M: Michael spent the afternoon propping up the sagging crossbeam over the lonely island's one doorway, wedging it back into place with a green branch snapped off the nearby shrub and a second cut from the tree for good measure, while Vincent stood underneath narrating the afternoon's Official Rescue Rankings.
whereabouts.N: Nikita worked the abandoned town houses south to north, came out with tinned peaches and a pair of enormous sunglasses, and maintained, at volume, that she had owned them since long before the boat went down.
whereabouts.O: Olivia trod water nearby with great composure, counting the exact number of people south of her for what she was fairly sure was the third or fourth time that hour, and declining to worry until the numbers gave her a reason to.
whereabouts.V: Vincent paced the shore of the loneliest island in the archipelago with a pencil and a plank of driftwood, drawing up the Official Rescue Rankings for all sixteen of them and awarding himself, after careful and entirely impartial deliberation, first place.

reveal: It was Michael, on Lonely Island — the only two people there, and the killer was alone with the victim. Michael had spent the whole afternoon 'fixing' the sagging crossbeam over the island's one doorway, wedging it back into place with a green branch cut from the shrub and a second prop broken off the lonely tree for good measure, while Vincent stood directly underneath, reading through the Official Rescue Rankings from the top. When he reached the bottom of the list — Michael, last, behind the sandcastle, behind the biscuits, behind the shark — Michael reached up, tapped the shrub-branch prop loose with two fingers, and stepped back to let the crossbeam do the actual work. By the time anyone came looking, he was over by the far wall, calmly checking the roof for storm damage.

escape.generic: The rescue helicopter took everyone home, the case was written up as reef damage and bad luck, and the one person who'd actually done it accepted a blanket, a biscuit, and a window seat without further comment.

byAccused.A: Ayla's shark log stopped mid-entry, and nobody ever did learn whether the patrol pattern held — least of all the real killer, who wasn't being watched by anyone.
byAccused.B: Bastian was hauled off still fused to his sunglasses, insisting to the last that the taller cactus had definitely had more water in it, while the real culprit toweled off nearby, entirely unbothered.
byAccused.C: "I was reciting maritime law to a shark," Cassius kept saying, as if that settled anything. "Ask the shark." Nobody, including the shark, could confirm it either way.
byAccused.D: The rescue crew spent a full ten minutes trying to explain to Denise that the object she'd been signalling was, and had always been, a bird, and she took that particular news worse than the arrest.
byAccused.E: Emma was pulled away still patting the funnel of her sand Periwinkle into shape, and the tide finished the job of destroying it before she was even off the beach.
byAccused.F: Fred's mayoral term ended in handcuffs, and Town Island's other three residents quietly agreed the office should stay vacant from now on — never once suspecting who should really have been standing in his place.
byAccused.G: Graham's sticks finally caught, spectacularly, about an hour after he was taken away, and the fire burned all night with nobody left who understood what it had cost him.
byAccused.H: Helena was led out of her spotless house still holding the broom, and made the arresting officers wipe their feet on the way in, which — to their credit — they did.
byAccused.I: Irene was still shouting the last of the peach inventory across the water when they came for her, and Nikita, to this day, never did hear the final number.
byAccused.J: Joseph was hauled away mid-shake, and the tree let go of its fruit not thirty seconds later, landing squarely on the spot where he'd been standing.
byAccused.K: Kent's locked door and his careful biscuit inventory were written up afterward as the behaviour of a man with something to hide, which was almost true, and entirely about the biscuits.
byAccused.L: "I was here first," Lyra told the arresting officer, from the shade, without getting up, "and frankly so were the sunglasses" — a defence that did not hold up in the slightest.
byAccused.N: Nikita was marched off still wearing the disputed sunglasses, which Lyra reclaimed within the hour and wore, pointedly, for the rest of the rescue.
byAccused.O: Olivia's count went permanently unfinished, one person short forever, and it needled at her far more than the arrest itself did.
